curator: This portfolio follows language I already loved before I could measure it: how partners talk on Couples Therapy, and the lyric world of Adrianne Lenker and Big Thief, with a stop in a 1982 Rolling Stone to get text off a scanned page. Two intimate corpora, six methods (human coding, prompt ablation, OCR, surface similarity, embeddings, and n-gram generation). Each time I was checking where a surface pattern stops being enough.
